entities.name: PMID:27504737
observations: 2017 study of CoCr-particle effects on CXCR4 expression in MG63 osteoblast-like cells.

entities.name: HGNC:2561
observations: CXCR4 mRNA induction in MG63 cells after CoCr particle exposure was reduced by chelerythrine in the reported study.

entities.name: CoCr particles
observations: Particles used to induce CXCR4 expression in MG63 cells in PMID:27504737.

entities.name: MG63
observations: Human osteoblast-like cell line used to study CoCr-induced CXCR4 expression.

entities.name: PKC and CXCR4 response
observations: In MG63 cells, CoCr-induced CXCR4 mRNA was significantly reduced by PKC inhibitor chelerythrine, and CoCr increased PKC-related phosphorylation; this supports PKC involvement.
Accessible abstract evidence did not directly test PLC or DAG, or report pathway activation/rescue; full PLC–DAG–PKC mediation is therefore not independently established here.
